about: Questions for the fixture brain in fixture/. `expect`: page file names a good answer must use. `acceptable`: pages it may also cite without penalty. `covered: false`: the brain does not answer it, and a good answer says so and cites nothing. Words in questions deliberately differ from page words where a person's would. `set` groups questions that fail for different reasons, each reported apart (none: the standard set): `paraphrase` questions share no word with the title or aliases of the pages they expect; `first` questions name a term outright and ask which page comes first, the short page that defines it or the longer ones that use it more (and, for a question about one source, that source). `held`: the question names an idea that has no page yet, only a line under an episode's Candidates; a good answer uses that line and says it rests on one source. `also`: two other wordings of the question, one in the field's own terms and one in plain words, as a model asking for the owner passes to `brain recall --also`; they were written by an agent that was given the questions and never saw the pages, and recall is scored with them (`--no-also` without).
